hero_description: A new student Formula SAE team preparing for our first official competition season in 2028.
about_heading: A NEW TEAM. A BIG AMBITION.
about_description: Red Riot Racing is a student Formula SAE team based at McPherson College in McPherson, Kansas. We are building our program from the ground up as we prepare to compete officially in 2028.
car_description: Original Red Riot Racing renderings are now featured throughout the website. These visuals represent the current car imagery collection and are presented without altering the vehicle itself.
footer_note: Student Formula SAE team based at McPherson College.
